entry.title: New R21 funding to study PFAS and placental imprinting

link.title: New R21 funding to study PFAS and placental imprinting

entry.content: Our NIEHS R21 (ES039048), “Identifying PFAS-Induced Disruption of Placental Imprinting and Neurodevelopment Through Multi-Omic Negative Control Calibration,” has been funded! This project builds on our placental genomics work to understand how PFAS exposures disrupt placental imprinting and downstream neurodevelopment.

entry.title: New preprint and software: ICONIC
entry.content: Check out ICONIC, our new R package for integrating instrumental variable- and negative-control-informed causal discovery and diagnostics in multiomic studies. Led by Sean with Charis, Taylor, and Yung-Han, in collaboration with the Huang Lab.

entry.title: Two new preprints on placental PFAS effects and breast cancer isoforms

link.title: Two new preprints on placental PFAS effects and breast cancer isoforms

entry.content:
Two new preprints from the lab are out on bioRxiv:

  • Sean’s work with the Huang Lab showing that natural variation in transplacental transfer efficiency exposes distinct transcriptional network architectures of PFAS effects on birth weight and gestational age.
  • Taylor’s work improving isoform-level eQTL and integrative genetic analyses of breast cancer risk with long-read RNA transcript assemblies, with Aryun, Yung-Han, and Sean.
